export.editable_reopen.method: For FreeCAD, independently reopen/recompute the trusted-exported native document in isolation and compare its solid, dimensions, holes, bounds within linearMm (0.01 mm), relative volume within stepRelativeVolume (0.00001), and geometric symmetric difference <= differenceVolumeMm3 (0.01 mm3) against checked STEP. Deliver source and describe actual native history. For build123d, regenerate from delivered editable source in a separate isolated generator without verifier authority, stop that generator and seal its STEP, then compare in a fresh trusted verifier using the same measurements. Any Python regeneration for either engine follows this separation; the verifier never executes candidate Python. If the required reopen/regeneration cannot run, return not_evaluated and block acceptance.

export.step_reopen.method: Reopen the actual registered STEP export bytes in a fresh trusted verifier and compare with the sealed checked candidate: valid single solid, frame/bounds, required dimensions and holes. Require absolute volume difference divided by positive checked-candidate volume <= stepRelativeVolume (0.00001); use geometric symmetric-difference volume <= differenceVolumeMm3 (0.01 mm3) to detect equal-volume substitutions. Export STEP byte identity must match the sealed geometry hash; if an exporter changes bytes, reseal and revalidate as new evidence before acceptance. Record export hash and independent measurements; verify downloaded-byte identity at delivery.

export.stl_reopen.method: Reopen the actual trusted-exported STL bytes independently, with manifest units explicitly mm. Require finite vertices, a closed consistently oriented watertight connected mesh, positive enclosed volume and agreement with checked candidate bounds/dimensions and hole layout within linearMm (0.01 mm). Compare absolute enclosed-volume difference divided by checked-candidate volume <= stlRelativeVolume (0.001). Inspect full-height bore openings and feature bounds on the mesh, not the generator report. Bind the registered STL byte hash and verify the downloaded bytes against it; inability to measure a required property is not_evaluated.

feature.requested_change.method: For tactile_feature_v1, independently compute added solid A = candidate minus trusted revised baseline. Require volume(A) > 1 mm3, with no tolerance relaxation of this strict lower bound. Measure A bounding spans and require X in [8,10], Y in [3,5], Z in [2,2] mm with linearMm (0.01 mm) at each range boundary. Require volume(A outside [20,30] x [25,30] x [5,7]) <= differenceVolumeMm3 (0.01 mm3), and baseline-minus-candidate volume <= 0.01 mm3. Confirm the raised addition joins the baseline as one valid connected solid and verify total bounds separately. This checks generated shape geometry, not a preset operation, visual styling claim or candidate-declared touched region.

geometry.requested_dimensions.method: Measure boundary planes, X/Y extents and base thickness from reopened geometry in the trusted frame, using absolute error <= linearMm (0.01 mm). For resize_centered_v1 compare against the confirmed version-specific length, width 35 and thickness 5, with bounds [0,L] x [0,35] x [0,5]. For tactile_feature_v1 require the unchanged baseline footprint [0,50] x [0,35] and base layer z=0..5; inspect base cross-sections against the trusted baseline rather than calling total height base thickness. Added material has separately checked height 2 and total candidate bounds [0,50] x [0,35] x [0,7], within linearMm.

geometry.valid_single_solid.method: In a fresh trusted verifier, reopen the sealed candidate STEP without executing candidate source. Require one nonempty connected valid solid, finite bounds and positive finite volume; reject invalid topology, extra solids and nonfinite measurements. Record actual bounds and volume in the immutable setup frame, independently of candidate assertions.

holes.layout.method: From independently reopened geometry, identify the two Z-axis diameter-6 through-bores, measure diameters, axes, center separation 20 and through-depth. Compare diameter, pitch and each center coordinate within linearMm (0.01 mm). Resize centers are ((L-20)/2,17.5) and ((L+20)/2,17.5) for the confirmed length L; feature centers remain (15,17.5) and (35,17.5). Test the trusted bore volumes and sections over the full candidate Z extent for continuity and obstruction, including material above z=5; reject a cap or plug. Do not substitute candidate hole labels, base-only depth or a volume allowance for the unobstructed-bore requirement.

interface.protected_region.method: For tactile_feature_v1, load the trusted revised reference STEP by its registered hash and independently compare baseline and candidate material clipped to the same two fixed cylinders centered at (15,17.5) and (35,17.5), radius 4 mm, z=0..5. Each clipped symmetric-difference volume must be <= differenceVolumeMm3 (0.01 mm3). Also require the full baseline-minus-candidate removed-material volume <= 0.01 mm3 to preserve all baseline material. Recheck both diameter-6 bores over the full candidate extent under holes.layout; a protected base neighborhood alone cannot detect a cap above it.

margin.end_material.method: Measure the shortest material distances between the outer bore boundaries and their corresponding X-min/X-max plate end faces on independently reopened geometry; report both closest-point pairs and their minimum. Pass only when this measured minimum + linearMm (0.01 mm) >= minimumEndMaterialMm (5 mm). Use setup-specific hole locations and confirmed length. The centered formula (L-20-6)/2 is a fixture expectation only and must not replace geometric distance measurement.
